programmes.d: Lynn and David Bush seem to be the perfect couple, but Lynn begins to suspect her husband is being unfaithful.
Cassie and Brent's rocky relationship, marked by jealousy and betrayal, comes to a tragic end.
A blackjack habit ends in tragedy for Gary and Helen, sending one of them behind bars and to the morgue.
Millionaire aerospace executives Lynn and Manfred Schockner hide a rage that erupts into a deadly conspiracy.
Julian falls hard for his much-younger coworker Teresa, but a sordid affair plunges him into a deep abyss.
Pegye meets Eric in Newport Beach, but their seemingly perfect lives soon unravel into a nightmare.
A young woman is abducted by another woman who tries to steal her unborn baby from her body. A geologist is attacked by a 500 pound grizzly bear.
A young nurse is abducted and tortured by a serial killer who has already murdered four other women; a mother and her four year old daughter are trapped in the attic.
A probe into how the justice system uses psychics to solve tough cases. Looks at how widespread the practice is, and whether or not psychic evidence holds up in court.
Kenny Richey is scheduled to die for setting a fire designed to kill his ex-girlfriend that wound up killing a 2-year-old child.
A young married couple's photographs of their vacation give police the clues they need to implicate the pair in the murders of two other Ocean City, Maryland vacationers.

Stacey Lannert sits in a Missouri prison, convicted of murdering her father. At the trial, she claimed that she killed him after years of sexual abuse and threats, but the jury didn't believe her. Do you?
A marriage gone bad. An affair. A bitter divorce. In 1994 in Jefferson, Wisconsin, it all led to the shooting death of Ruben Borchardt, a 40-year-old father of three.
A look at one of the most shocking and controversial cases in Hawaiian history--the 1991 rape and murder of beautiful 23-year-old Dana Ireland.
When a woman is poisoned by an obscure plant, detectives launch an undercover operation to outsmart a bookish murder mystery buff with a short fuse.
A Texas father takes his spoiled teenage daughter to an exclusive Caribbean resort and somehow ends up packed in his own suitcase.
A homicidal vegan gelato maker gets her just desserts after two bodies are found in her freezer.
The head of a family-run maple syrup business disappears, and a psychic claims she's buried somewhere in the sugar shack.
A plastic surgeon's wife disappears, and police eventually uncover a body behind a video arcade and a Tickle Trunk worthy of blackmail and murder.
When an animal-loving loner fails to show up for Christmas dinner, detectives find the man dead in his trailer, alongside the feathery corpse of his lovebird and BFF.
When the body of a soap opera star is found behind a dumpster in Los Angeles, detectives unravel a sordid plot.
Investigators suspect two grannies are behind a twisted insurance scam, but they have to find the evidence that ties them to a hit-and-run.
A Miami cocktail waitress tells her scandalous truth on a tell-all game show and ends up dead.
When a Mexican millionaire disappears, a shrewd undercover cop gets the perp to cough up the murder weapon.
At the Paris Opera House, an infatuated stagehand takes on the murderous role of the villain.
